messages:
Ravi: Hi payroll — I had a PTO cashout on the Dec 10 run. Payslip shows Gross PTO cashout $2,000 but there's a state tax line for CA $300. I live and work in WA (no state income tax). Is that expected?
Nate: I've seen WA folks get CA withholding when their payroll record still had CA from onboarding. Might be state of record mismatch.
Marta (Payroll): Thanks for flagging. Can you confirm the state on your Workday payroll profile and attach the payslip PDF? We usually withhold based on the state of record at run time.
Ravi: Workday shows WA (changed in July). Uploaded payslip as "payslip_dec_ptocashout.pdf" and screenshot of Workday address change.
Marta (Payroll): OK sending to state-tax team to audit. If the run used a cached profile with CA, we can reallocate and issue a corrective adjustment. Please also attach the confirmation of address change email or timestamped record.
Ravi: Uploaded the change confirmation. Case created PR-2026-834.
PeopleOps Bot: Ticket PR-2026-834 created and assigned to team:state-tax. Estimated review 5 business days.
Marta (Payroll): Quick note: if we confirm mis-withholding we'll credit the net in the next payrun and issue an amended W-2 or state form if needed. Leaving this open until resolved :thumbsup:
